0.original: Cahciua is ready to take to the sky on mehwapyarra-back.

48.original: I know one shouldn't judge by appearance, but still...

49.original: Hello there! Come to ride the mehwapyarras, have you?

50.original: Begging your pardon, but this is where you can go on leisure flights, yes?

51.original: Indeed it is! Bearing you will be our adorable mehwapyarras, who are especially trained by a Turali friend!

52.original: Just say the word, and we will send you up, up, and away!

53.original: And there you have it! Shall we, then?

54.original: It seems I'll have to trust to the theory of ancestral levitational predisposition...

55.original: In case you are unfamiliar, the theory holds that all life-forms have an innate capacity for levitational magicks. While said magicks generally remain latent, they may manifest in the ability to fly.

56.original: My guess is that the mehwapyarras themselves cannot fly, but rather their saddles are imbued with levitation magicks.

57.original: You are ready? Then go ahead and mount up. The mehwapyarras fly a set route, so you need only relax and enjoy the view!

60.original: I'll be damned... They really do fly...

61.original: Hey, the way we're flying in formation, don't we look like migrating birds?

63.original: Speaking of migrating birds, the mallard is where your name comes from. Did I ever tell you that?

64.original: That I knew, but I learned it from the shamaness, not from you.

65.original: A migrating bird can fly anywhere it desires─even across oceans to distant continents.

66.original: And you've done just that, my clever mallard!

67.original: I'd thank you not to call me that!

68.original: Oh dear, is it over already? Time really does <hex:021A020203>fly<hex:021A020103> when you have fun!

69.original: What a joy to see Living Memory from up high!

71.original: Ahhh, that was wonderful! An experience worth saving for the very end!

72.original: You two enjoyed yourselves as well, I trust?

73.original: It was enjoyable enough, I suppose.

74.original: From my fussy bunbun, that's high praise. I'm glad I invited you and <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

77.original: If I could, I'd go for another hundred rides, but I must settle for the one.

78.original: It's time we were headed to the Aero Terminal. If there are still things you wish to do, you'll want to do them now.

79.original: When you're ready, make your way along the path yonder. I'll find the others and let them know the same.

80.original: Please come and fly again any time!

81.original: She's only a facsimile constructed from her memories. I understand this.

82.original: But when she's right there, as alive and spirited as I've ever known her, how am I supposed to do it? How am I supposed to erase her?

83.original: Does she even know how it tears me apart?

85.original: We saw you from below. It looked like you were having fun.

86.original: It will be hard, but let us send Cahciua off with a smile.

88.original: I couldn't have asked for more fulfilling final hours than these.

89.original: I'm so happy to have met you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. You and everyone. Thank you for the memories.

90.original: And thank you for watching over my Elene'shpya. He'll be fine now, I know it.

91.original: No more doubts. I will shut the terminal down.

92.original: Let's see our task through to the end.

93.original: We carry on, with their hopes and memories in our hearts.

94.original: We'll leave this to you, Erenville.

95.original: Aye, I won't waver. Not anymore.

96.original: If you're ready yourselves, then so am I.

97.original: Upon shutting down the Aero Terminal, it will not be possible to restore Windspath Gardens to its present form.

98.original: Are you certain you wish to shut down the terminal?

100.original: We won't let Cahciua's hopes be in vain!

101.original: No time for tears... Just as well.

102.original: Not a moment too soon... It's as if she's saying she won't let us do as we please anymore.

103.original: Through our time here, we've come to know what it is Sphene seeks to protect.

104.original: But that doesn't change what we have to do!
